opportunities.title: Record humanoid manipulation demonstrations
opportunities.summary: Use the selected robot’s supported teleoperation stack to collect human-guided arm and hand demonstrations for a learning dataset in a controlled laboratory.

reviewLinks.rationale: Unitree documents G1/Dex3 teleoperation, episode recording and physical hardware setup.
limitations: A human provides the demonstrated actions.
Validate the exact camera, hands, software and workspace before collection.

reviewLinks.rationale: The H2 PLUS reference explicitly supports Isaac TeleOp demonstration collection.
limitations: Human-guided data collection; not autonomous task operation.
Validate exact hand/camera calibration, software versions and workspace.

opportunities.title: Test learned manipulation policies on a physical humanoid
opportunities.summary: Develop and evaluate manipulation policies with a configured humanoid learning stack. Physical experiments require delivered hardware, compatible software and researcher supervision; see each robot’s evidence stage.

reviewLinks.rationale: The official learning repository includes G1_29/dex3 physical evaluation and dataset replay.
limitations: Simulation and dataset evaluation are distinct from live robot execution.
A research example does not establish broad object handling or unattended operation.

reviewLinks.rationale: The official H2 PLUS reference connects GR00T models, Sim/Lab evaluation and ROS deployment to onboard Thor inference.
limitations: Announced reference workflow; no reproduced task benchmark or unattended production established.
Hardware access, delivered software and safe physical test conditions remain to be confirmed.

opportunities.title: Trial humanoid drilling in an experimental assembly line
opportunities.summary: Investigate tool positioning and drilling with a configured humanoid research platform. Historical experiments require fresh validation of quality and operation.

reviewLinks.rationale: PAL identifies TALOS drilling trials in the finished Memmo project and its ICRA 2020 research demonstration.
limitations: Historical research evidence from the 2018–2022 project.
No accepted production throughput, hole quality or turnkey drilling package established.

opportunities.title: Develop force-controlled humanoid handling
opportunities.summary: Use joint torque feedback and whole-body control to research object and tool handling in a supervised laboratory cell.

reviewLinks.rationale: PAL specifies torque control, configurable grippers and 6 kg per fully extended arm for TALOS.
limitations: Research-platform capabilities are not a completed task implementation.
Review torque-sensor exceptions, tooling mass and the experiment-specific controller.
